topics.title: Observability
topics.description: Use logs, metrics, and traces to explain system behavior.
learningGoals: Use logs, metrics, and traces to explain system behavior.
Explain the tradeoffs and demonstrate one failure or boundary case.
examples: Apply observability to a session, coupon, or token lifecycle. Compare a successful operation with one that must be rejected.

topics.title: Retries
topics.description: Retry transient failures with limits and avoid repeating unsafe side effects.
learningGoals: Retry transient failures with limits and avoid repeating unsafe side effects.
Explain Transient failures, Backoff and Bounded attempts.
Demonstrate a valid operation and a boundary or failure case.
examples: A payment request times out after the provider may have charged it. Retry only with an idempotency strategy and a bounded policy.

tasks.title: Explain Retries in your own words
Work through the example and predict the result
Check a boundary or failure case without AI implementation help

topics.title: Idempotency
topics.description: Make duplicate requests produce a stable outcome.
learningGoals: Make duplicate requests produce a stable outcome.
Explain Request identity, Stable result and Duplicate effects.
Demonstrate a valid operation and a boundary or failure case.
examples: Two identical refund requests with the same idempotency key should return the same result without issuing two refunds.
